personal.title: DevOps & Cloud Architect
personal.bio: I am a DevOps and Cloud Engineer, harnessing over six years of expertise in crafting, automating, and nurturing Cloud infrastructure and environments. As a quick learner and team player, I bring a blend of skills and a keen interest in AI, backed by a background in Management and Engineering, granting me a distinctive outlook within the team.

highlightCard.description: Proven record of cloud cost optimization, zero-downtime Kubernetes migrations, and enterprise observability across Italy’s top payment & identity providers.

experienceCounter.title: Total Experience as a DevOps Engineer
experienceCounter.description: Continuously orchestrating AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, and Terraform pipelines since May 2020.

Migrating on-premises applications to cloud platforms
Administering databases and overseeing observability measures
Co-ordinating with a group of developers spanning different projects.
Facilitate deployment automation and CI/CD. Monitoring and observability.
Reduce bottlenecks (Build times, latency) and optimize costs (Rescaling resources)

Helm, Kustomize, Argo CD, OpenShift, K9s

items.description: The personal portfolio and interactive CV web application you are viewing now. Built with React, Vite, and Tailwind CSS.
highlights: Engineered a high-performance personal portfolio featuring dynamic JSON-driven localization in English, Italian, and Spanish.
Implemented interactive 3D modal decks, light/dark theme switching, live experience uptime counters, and smooth Framer Motion animations.
Technologies used: React 18, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, and FontAwesome icons.

items.text: GitOps continuous delivery with Argo CD
items.description: Multi-cluster Kubernetes GitOps continuous delivery demonstration with Argo CD, Helm, and HAProxy load balancing.
highlights: Demonstrates declarative multi-cluster GitOps using Argo CD ApplicationSets to synchronize microservices across clusters.
Configured local multi-cluster topology using Kind, automated Helm chart releases, and Ingress-Nginx controllers.
Integrated an HAProxy load balancer distributing client traffic across clusters using round-robin health checks.
Technologies used: Argo CD, Kubernetes, Helm, Kind, HAProxy, Ingress-Nginx, and GitOps workflows.

items.text: Fleet configuration and automation with Ansible
items.description: Automated configuration, compliance auditing, and rolling patch management for a multi-node Linux server fleet.
highlights: Automated base configuration, SSH hardening, sysctl kernel optimizations, and Nginx health monitoring across Ubuntu/Debian nodes.
Built automated audit playbooks producing timestamped compliance reports and pending package update statuses.
Implemented rolling zero-downtime patching playbooks with interactive confirmation, reboot handling, and verification checks.
Technologies used: Ansible, Vagrant, Ubuntu, Debian, Nginx, Systemd, and Bash scripting.

items.text: Deploying a scalable IaaS web server in Azure using Terraform
items.description: Scalable and secure IaaS web server infrastructure deployed on Microsoft Azure using HashiCorp Packer and Terraform.
highlights: Created custom hardened Linux VM images using HashiCorp Packer and Azure CLI credentials.
Provisioned high-availability virtual machine scale sets, virtual networks, and load balancers using modular Terraform templates.
Enforced enterprise cloud governance by implementing Azure Policies and Network Security Groups to restrict unauthorized inbound traffic.
Technologies used: Terraform, Packer, Microsoft Azure, Azure CLI, Bash, and Linux.

items.text: Building a CI/CD pipeline using Azure pipelines & GitHub Actions
items.description: Automated CI/CD delivery pipeline deploying a containerized Flask ML prediction web service to Azure App Services.
highlights: Built continuous integration and testing workflows in GitHub Actions with Makefile automation and linting.
Architected an Azure DevOps pipeline to automatically build and deploy a Flask machine learning application to Azure App Service.
Configured cloud monitoring, live prediction API testing endpoints, and end-to-end deployment verification.
Technologies used: Azure Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Python 3.7, Flask, Azure CLI, and Scikit-Learn.

items.text: Ensuring quality releases with API, functional & perf testing
items.description: Enterprise CI/CD quality gate pipeline integrating infrastructure provisioning with automated functional, API, and load tests.
highlights: Provisioned cloud infrastructure on Microsoft Azure using Terraform and self-hosted build agents.
Integrated automated API integration testing suites with Postman/Newman and browser functional testing using Selenium.
Executed automated stress and performance testing using Apache JMeter to establish latency baselines and prevent regressions.
Technologies used: Terraform, Azure App Service, Selenium WebDriver, Postman, Apache JMeter, and Python.

items.text: Automated Docker Image Creation, VM Provisioning, and Kubernetes Deployment
items.description: Cloud-native web application pipeline with Docker containerization, GitHub Actions CI, and Kubernetes deployment.
highlights: Containerized a Flask microservice with Docker and configured continuous image delivery to Docker Hub via GitHub Actions.
Provisioned a local multi-node development environment using Vagrant and deployed lightweight Kubernetes (k3s).
Authored declarative Kubernetes manifests (Namespace, Deployment, Service) for high-availability pod scheduling.
Technologies used: Docker, Kubernetes, k3s, GitHub Actions, Vagrant, Python, and Flask.

items.text: Best coding practices and unit test
items.description: Production-grade customer churn prediction library adhering to PEP8 standards, clean architecture, and comprehensive testing.
highlights: Refactored legacy machine learning code into modular, production-ready Python libraries with extensive docstrings.
Achieved high code quality scores (> 9.0/10) validated with Pylint and automated formatting with autopep8.
Implemented unit testing and logging mechanisms with Pytest to guarantee model reproducibility and runtime safety.
Technologies used: Python, Scikit-Learn, Pandas, Pytest, Pylint, and Matplotlib.

items.text: Online travel app using multiple APIs
items.description: Asynchronous travel planner dashboard that aggregates real-time weather forecasts, destination imagery, and attractions.
highlights: Built an asynchronous Node/Express backend communicating with Geonames, Weatherbit, Pixabay, and Google Places APIs.
Dynamically generates city forecasts, countdown days, destination photography, and local attractions based on user input.
Configured production Webpack build chains with Sass compilation, service workers, and responsive styling.
Technologies used: JavaScript (ES6+), Node.js, Express, Webpack, Babel, and external REST APIs.

items.text: Dynamic section navigation page in JavaScript
items.description: Interactive single-page web UI featuring an auto-generated navigation menu, smooth scrolling, and viewport tracking.
highlights: Dynamically parses document sections to construct responsive navigation links on the fly using vanilla DOM methods.
Integrated smooth scroll behavior and active viewport detection powered by the Intersection Observer API.
Optimized layout for high rendering performance without third-party frameworks or bulky libraries.
Technologies used: Vanilla JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, and modern Web APIs.

items.text: An asynchronous Weather Journal app using OpenWeatherMap API
items.description: Asynchronous web application tracking local atmospheric conditions, dates, and user journal reflections in real time.
highlights: Developed an Express server managing asynchronous GET and POST endpoints to store and retrieve journal entries.
Fetched real-time meteorological conditions from the OpenWeatherMap API using modern async/await fetch calls.
Updated the dynamic user interface seamlessly with clean Materialize CSS responsive components.
Technologies used: JavaScript (ES6+), Node.js, Express.js, OpenWeatherMap API, and Materialize CSS.

items.text: Evaluate a news article with Natural Language Processing
items.description: Web app that analyzes sentiment, subjectivity, and polarity of news article URLs using Natural Language Processing.
highlights: Connected an Express backend with Aylien Natural Language Processing API to evaluate user-submitted article URLs.
Extracted sentiment polarity, confidence scores, and subjectivity analysis presented in an interactive card interface.
Set up Webpack build pipeline, Babel transpilation for backwards compatibility, and automated Jest test suites.
Technologies used: JavaScript (ES6+), Node.js, Express, Webpack, Babel, Jest, and Aylien NLP API.

items.text: Multi-page Blog website with HTML and pure CSS
items.description: Clean, minimalist multi-page static blog crafted exclusively with semantic HTML5 and responsive pure CSS3.
highlights: Designed and styled a lightweight multi-page blog layout without any client-side JavaScript dependencies.
Engineered responsive grid and flexbox card systems with accessible contrast and modern typography.
Focused on cross-browser compatibility, rapid page loading speeds, and optimal Core Web Vitals performance.
Technologies used: Semantic HTML5, CSS3, Flexbox, CSS Grid, and Media Queries.

items.text: Applying Artificial Intelligence techniques in Project Management
items.description: Master's thesis examining machine learning and artificial intelligence methods applied to project scheduling and risk forecasting.
highlights: Investigated modern machine learning models for risk identification, duration forecasting, and resource leveling.
Analyzed decision-making frameworks combining operational research with neural network heuristics.
Published research presented at Politecnico di Torino.

items.text: Design of a UAV with Variable-Span Morphing Wing
items.description: Aerodynamic research and CAD/FEM design of an unmanned aerial vehicle featuring an adaptive variable-span wing.
highlights: Explored mechanical actuation systems and aerodynamic efficiency of variable-span morphing wing concepts.
Performed CFD aerodynamic analyses across varied flight regimes to optimize lift-to-drag ratios.
Published on ResearchGate detailing structural integrity and mission flexibility.

items.text: States of Stress and Strain in a Semi-Infinite Plate
items.description: Mathematical and numerical stress-strain distribution analysis in semi-infinite elastic plates under mechanical boundaries.
highlights: Derived analytical solutions for stress tensors in semi-infinite elastic domains using Airy stress functions.
Validated boundary conditions and localized deformation gradients using numerical modeling.

items.text: Analysis of a Catapult-Launched Delta-Wing Glider
items.description: Launch dynamics, trim stability, and glide performance analysis of a catapult-assisted delta-wing glider.
highlights: Modeled trajectory kinematics and pitch-yaw stability derivatives during high-g catapult launch phases.
Evaluated vortex lift generation and stall characteristics of low-aspect-ratio delta-wing geometries.

items.text: Conceptual Design of a Surface-to-Air Missile
items.description: Comprehensive aerospace systems design study including propulsion sizing, aerodynamic control, and guidance trajectories.
highlights: Conducted multi-disciplinary conceptual sizing for solid-propellant propulsion, fin aerodynamics, and mass fractions.
Modeled proportional navigation guidance laws and intercept envelope simulations against airborne targets.

items.text: Plane Stress Analysis of a Rectangular Plate Subjected to a Concentrated Load
items.description: Finite element and theoretical plane stress evaluation of isotropic rectangular plates bearing localized point loads.
highlights: Compared theoretical Navier solutions with 2D finite element simulations for localized high-stress concentrations.
Analyzed principal stress distributions, deflection curves, and von Mises yield thresholds.
